# ceph_cluster_users (Data Source)

Lists all CephX cluster users (`ceph auth` entities). Secret keys are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_cluster_users" "all" {}

output "cluster_user_entities" {
  value = [for u in data.ceph_cluster_users.all.users : u.entity]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) All CephX cluster users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))
